description: List the EDI item mappings (cross-references): which Spark item each trading partner's SKU or UPC stands for, with the customer's description, unit, the conversion to the Spark unit and the customer price. Filter by tradingPartnerId, itemId or a search over the customer SKU, UPC and description and the item's SKU and name. Paged (page, pageSize up to 200). Requires an operator (unpinned) credential.

itemId.description: Only mappings to this Spark item (GUID).

search.description: Case-insensitive text to find in the customer SKU, UPC or description, or the item's SKU or name.

name: list_edi_item_mappings
title: List EDI Item Mappings
